title: P20-M ‘shabu’ seized, drug suspect nabbed in Zamboanga buy-bust

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY – Authorities arrested a high-value drug suspect and seized P20.4 million worth of suspected shabu during a joint buy-bust operation in Barangay Mercedes, Zamboanga City on Wednesday afternoon. The suspect was identified as alias “Kah,” 30, a resident of Barangay Gata in Talipao town, Sulu province. Police listed him as among the major drug suspects in the Zamboanga Peninsula or Region 9.
